contract.ownership: One live session per DLL; all session calls on creating OS thread; no concurrent or reentrant calls; Destroy before FreeLibrary.
contract.ownerWindow: Project-owned hidden focus window; idle owner dispatches Windows messages, WM_CLOSE does not bypass device cleanup, explicit owner-thread Destroy releases the device before the window.
contract.input: Frozen FRM1 v1/v2 model packets or explicit typed FRM1 v3 with independent accessory feature16 and optional full UV trailer; scope4-only FRM1 v4/feature2048 adds complete hidden-model material metadata with zero drawing geometry. SHA-bound VIS1 v2/v3, typed VIS1 v4 or exactly paired VIS1 v5. No animation or physics advancement.
contract.additionalUvValidation: Transport/parser CPU contracts are verified separately; SubTexture SM3 sampling and legacy pixel equality still require real GPU verification before product registration.
contract.output: Caller-owned top-down RGBA8 with validated stride/capacity; opaque background only.
contract.scope: Isolated scope1 retains synthetic path metadata. Opt-in configured scope2/scope3/scope4 expose frozen real model/accessory metadata. Scope4 applies copied EMM mappings; effect autodiscovery remains disabled.
contract.exceptionIsolation: A C++ exception escaping host BeginScene poisons the session; later Capture/Resize are refused, only owner-thread Destroy is allowed. This adapter cannot guarantee arbitrary host OOM rollback or leak freedom.
contract.editorOverlay: Preview-only feature16384; PresentV2 appends bounded copied editor primitives to the V1 prefix. Depth-aware guides are drawn before MME post-processing and composited afterward; Capture and accessory screen inputs exclude editor overlays.
contract.objectFx: Opt-in internal OBJECT_FX=256/scope2; copied immutable object/subset map; root FX read-share leases; caller freezes all transitive dependencies until Destroy. Actual D3DX/SAS object/standard admission only; no scene, offscreen, controls, ScriptExternal, feedback or repeated render turns; no full MME/EMM claim.
contract.packageResources: Optional copied origin/materialized path map, immutable leases, no source or CWD fallback; old V1 preserved. Feature512 required before session creation; same scope2 frame format.
contract.sceneFx: Opt-in scope3/feature1024; copied V2 package resource map, existing host scene/offscreen and descending repeat execution; one frozen sample per frame. Failed scene execution requires Destroy. Runtime acceptance is separately recorded, not implied by source/build.
contract.accessories: Typed independent 64-bit identities, original raw split and exposed signed order (including original model0 sentinel), immutable local X geometry plus sampled world once, native-name parent and separate source tables, stored D3D9 material conversion, fixed texture cascade and original alpha test. Source implementation and GPU acceptance are separate; screen-media/shadow/outline passes are not silently approximated.
contract.emm: Explicit scope4/feature4096 copied EMM sections, independent whole/subset visibility presence, exact opaque64 record bindings and all-live frozen root decisions. Reuses existing host apply; all mapped FILE values compile under the leased package resolver. Optional independent feature2048 FRM4/VIS5 preserves real hidden-model materials/textures without dummy geometry; old scopes reject these packets. Runtime failures require Destroy; input validation does not mutate policy. Public ViewOutput adaptation is opt-in and is not editor production integration.
contract.dependencyInspector: CPU-only, no-session official D3DX compiler/reflection over callback-frozen sources; both fixed mip profiles plus metadata-required Function compilation. Shared fixed host metadata semantics. Source graph, not portability replay/PMC/App completion.
